text: Level two, question three: a pipe fills a tank in nine hours; because of a leak, it takes one hour longer; how long would the leak take to empty the full tank? Question four: pipes A and B fill a tank in twelve and fifteen hours; because of a leak, together they take ten hours; how long would the leak alone take to empty the full tank? Question five: a pipe fills a tank four times as fast as a leak empties it; with the leak, the tank fills in twenty hours; how long would the pipe take alone, and the leak alone?
